title: Admin-managed Share Your Photo background image (uploadable + fit controls with fallback)

requirements.summary: Render “Share Your Photo” section background from canister-stored image when present, otherwise fall back to the current static generated asset.
acceptanceCriteria: If no custom image has been uploaded for the “Share Your Photo” section, the UI continues to display /assets/generated/contact-woman-laundry.dim_800x600.jpg as it does today.
If a custom image has been uploaded, the “Share Your Photo” section displays that uploaded image instead of the hardcoded asset.
The custom image is stored in the canister and survives page refreshes.

file_operations.description: Add React Query hooks to fetch the current “Share Your Photo” background image from the canister (use the existing backend capability returning an ExternalBlob | null) and expose a stable queryKey for invalidation after admin updates. Use the blob-storage ExternalBlob capability (getDirectURL) for efficient image rendering; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Replace the hardcoded background source with a computed source that prefers the canister-provided image (via the new query hook) and falls back to the existing static asset (frontend/public/assets/generated/contact-woman-laundry.dim_800x600.jpg). Use blob-storage ExternalBlob.getDirectURL() for the custom image URL; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Provide an admin-only UI to upload/replace/remove the “Share Your Photo” background image with type/size validation and optional downscale processing.
acceptanceCriteria: Only admins can access the controls to upload/replace/remove the “Share Your Photo” section image.
The uploader accepts JPEG, PNG, or WebP images up to 10MB (consistent with the existing customer uploader constraints).
Admin can choose between (a) keep original size (no resize) and (b) auto-adjust size (downscale only; do not upscale).
After a successful upload, the “Share Your Photo” section updates to show the new image without requiring a full page reload.

file_operations.description: Add mutations for uploading/replacing and removing the “Share Your Photo” section background image using existing backend capabilities. Ensure mutations invalidate the query used by the Share Your Photo section so the UI updates without a full reload. Use blob-storage ExternalBlob.fromBytes + withUploadProgress for uploads; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create an admin-only manager component for the “Share Your Photo” background image: file picker + preview, validation (JPEG/PNG/WebP, <=10MB), mode toggle for keep-original vs auto-adjust (downscale only), upload progress, and a remove action. Leverage existing image processing utilities for downscale behavior and use blob-storage ExternalBlob for upload and preview URLs; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing. Gate the UI by admin role (authorization component concept via existing isAdmin checks); verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the new SharePhotoBackgroundManager into the AdminPanel as an additional admin tab/section (only visible when useIsCallerAdmin() indicates admin). Ensure unauthorized users never see the controls (authorization role-based access). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add an admin-controlled display fit mode (contain vs cover) for how the “Share Your Photo” background image is rendered while keeping the existing overlay styling.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can select a fit mode that maps to a clear rendering behavior (e.g., contain vs cover).
The chosen fit mode is applied when rendering the “Share Your Photo” section image.
The existing gradient overlay in the section remains in place and readable over the image.

file_operations.description: Add a small state hook to store and retrieve the “Share Your Photo” background fit mode (e.g., 'cover' | 'contain') for the site owner UI, persisting locally (e.g., localStorage) and exposing a simple getter/setter for both the admin control and the rendering component.

Add fit mode controls (contain vs cover) to the admin background manager UI and persist the selection via the new fit-mode hook. Ensure the control is clearly labeled and maps to the rendering behavior. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Apply the saved fit mode to the background image rendering (object-contain vs object-cover) while preserving the existing gradient overlay layers and readability. Keep the overlay DOM layering intact.
